styles.listLine: short everyday words, the delta only, no filler
rules: Use short, everyday words only; no big words, no jargon, no filler, no pleasantries.
Say only the delta: what changed since my last message, and nothing else.

styles.listLine: a rounded summary in normal words
rules: State what changed since my last message and what decision I need to make, if any.

styles.listLine: precise technical terms, still no filler
rules: Precise technical terminology is fine; name the real things.
State what changed and what decision I need to make; no filler, no pleasantries.

styles.listLine: fuller picture: what, why, and what is next
rules: Cover what changed, why it changed, and what happens next.
Plain prose, no filler; technical terms only where they earn their place.
